rows.en: Aurelie: "Anyway, we've got to do something about the ones around us
Kasumi: "A robot... Is this a Spirit... Mech?"
I can at least protect myself."
Touya: "You're the one who protected Kasumi? Thanks."
Getting rid of those monsters comes first.
Touya: "Are you sure you'll be okay?
I can take you along if you want..."
Bernst: "No, no. I'm not so tactless.
But I'd appreciate it if you'd look for me
Touya: "Got it. Then find somewhere safe... Guess there isn't anywhere.
Anyway, hide as far away as you can."
Bernst: "Yes. I'll do what I can..."
Touya: "I told you, stop calling me '-chan.'
Touya: "Well, anyway... I'm glad you're safe."
Kasumi: "...Yeah. It's a little cramped in here."
they must have technology like that too. Yes."
Yamato: "...You don't have to force a logical explanation..."
Touya: "Anyway, getting out of this mess comes first.
I'll explain everything later. For now, trust me!"
Ai: "Touya. I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll act
Clovis: "I'm acting independently. I'll leave your end to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I still can't trust you with my life.
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following orders.
Fain: "The burning spirit of justice still
doesn't dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
So I shall uphold my own justice! That is all!"
It's all right. I won't lose to those things.
It's lost itself in its rage!"
Touya: "...Yeah. Assuming it has a 'self' to lose."
It's all right. I won't lose to that thing.
Touya: "Calm down... Calm down... What do I do...?"
Touya: "L-Like this? I-It's a little heavy..."
Reduce: "Just like that. Take a slow, deep breath,
then imagine the air gathering at the tip of your blade."
Touya: "How am I supposed to... Right, imagine it."
Reduce: "That's right. Close your eyes and concentrate.
Touya: "Heh heh... All right! Let's finish this in one go!"
Aurelie: "Nothing. You just looked awfully close.
Fighting in each other's arms like that...
We've been together since we were kids..."
Even so, you looked just like a couple."
Celica: "You did. Oh, are you embarrassed?"
You don't have to be embarrassed."
Derock: "Hmm... You should just admit it.
You'll feel better if you spill it now."
Look, the two of us are..."
That's what I thought. Yep, yep."
Yamato: "Honestly, what are you saying in front of everyone?
You're putting Kasumi on the spot too, you know."
Yamato: "You have to say these things properly!
Touya, have you even told Kasumi
how you feel? You haven't, have you?!
Making a declaration like that in front of everyone
without her agreement... Think about Kasumi's
Yamato: "They're childhood friends, just like Touya said earlier."
Ai: (H-Huh? Why do I feel relieved?
Huh? No way! It can't be...)
Nothing hurts more than being unable to protect someone
Touya: "Xiujian, it's because you insisted on rescuing her.
Xiujian: "I only did what was right.
There's no need to thank me.
Arthur: "Oh, where are you going, Xiujian?"
Clovis: "He could stand to be a little more honest too."
Yamato: "Come to think of it, Kasumi, how did you end up
Touya: "Three months ago?! I've only been here
Ymir: "Kasumi was probably sent, just like you, Touya,
Touya: "Forzen said something like that too, but..."
Kasumi: "Things were different from the first day of the new term...
Forzen told me your existence, Touya-chan,
Touya: "The first day... When I saw Zeifon and Rayblade
Was that day the point where things branched off...?"
But nobody knew who you were, Touya-chan.
Not your classmates, Touya-chan, not even Koichiro... Nobody...
It was as if you, Touya-chan, had never existed
at all... I was scared, Touya-chan...
Touya: "And that's how you came here?"
Ai: "...So you wanted to see Touya so badly,
you decided to go somewhere you knew nothing about?"
Ai: "Childhood friend, glasses, straight black hair, devoted..."
Ai: (...Why am I getting so worked up...?
It shouldn't matter if she likes Touya...
But what is this? This unsettled feeling...)
Celica: "No use. Ai seems to be fighting a battle in her own world."
and we should probably give her a checkup too..."
Ymir: "Yes. Could you take care of that?"
I-I'm not... I mean... As a knight, um..."
If it's love at first sight, just say so."
Aurelie: "Huh? I thought Fain liked Ymir..."
Derock: "It's an age of many loves.
Touya: "Oh, right. Is there anyone around there?
Bernst: "...Well, I was starting to wonder
what I'd do if you left me there."
Touya: "Sorry, sorry. Thanks for helping Kasumi
back there. If you hadn't been there, who knows what would've happened..."
Bernst: "Not at all. Perhaps fate brought us together."
Ymir: "We'd like to thank you too..."
Ymir: "Um... Is there something on my face?"
I just thought you were such a young and beautiful captain..."
It'll just have the opposite effect...)
Celica: "...You don't look like a mercenary
Ymir: "A field covering the evolution of life and genetic engineering.
If I remember correctly, it even makes it possible
to create life artificially, doesn't it?"
Bernst: "Heh heh... Well, in theory, yes."
Touya: "What's a scholar like you doing
in a place like this? It's dangerous."
Many creatures are bound by emotions,
but none are as complex as humans.
but I found that young lady first."
Arthur: "So you entered this forest to find out
Bernst: "Yes. You can't know the truth of anything
Touya: "If you get yourself killed, it'll all be for nothing, won't it?"
Bernst: "Now that you mention it, yes.
I hadn't noticed. Ha ha ha ha!"
Ai: "He kind of reminds me of Forzen."
Touya: "Is everyone in this world like this?"
Ymir: "Um, Bernst, do you intend to continue
Bernst: "Hmm, that would be fine too...
But with the rumored Spirit Mechs right in front of me,
doing nothing would offend my pride.
Bernst: "Despite appearances, I can keep a secret."
We will certainly be throwing ourselves
into battle. It's dangerous to be with us."
Bernst: "You needn't concern yourselves with me.
If I'm caught up in it and die, that will be my own responsibility.
Besides, I don't intend to stay forever.
I'll simply be a passenger. I promise I won't interfere
Ymir: "You're right. It is too dangerous."
I'll tell you what I know about Zigrim's Armored Mechs.
In return, you'll help with my research."
Arthur: "...A bargain? You certainly came prepared."
There are others interested in this forest... No, in Baluamy.
Celica: "You mean a Zigrim survey team has come
Bernst: "No. A capture unit, rather than a survey team.
They were clearly military. With the latest equipment, too."
Celica: "Did you happen to get hold of parts
Bernst: "Yes. It matches the time when
Zigrim, which had been relatively backward technologically,
suddenly began developing new Armored Mechs at a rapid pace.
People like those in ≪Ze=Ode≫, for example."
Bernst: "This is still just my speculation,
but I don't think I'm mistaken."
Bernst: "I still have the parts from that time.
Bernst: "Ah, ah. In exchange for permission to research."
Bernst, I'll permit you to board,
Celica: "...So this is... Oh... Hmm... I see..."
Ymir: "For now, let's leave the parts analysis to Celica
and return to the Holy Land. Shall we?"
